questions.prompt: What's the accessible way to make the first row of a data range act as column headers?
choices: Bold the text in that row
Use Insert > Table (or Format as Table) so the row is recognized as headers
Increase the font size of that row

questions.prompt: Why is merging cells to center a heading across several columns a problem for screen reader users?
choices: It isn't a problem - merged cells are fully accessible
It makes the file size much larger
A screen reader can't tell which column a merged header actually belongs to

questions.prompt: A workbook is shared with tabs still named "Sheet1", "Sheet2", and "Sheet3". What should change before sharing it?
choices: Nothing - sheet tab names don't matter for accessibility
The tabs should be renamed to something meaningful, since a screen reader announces the tab name when switching sheets
The tabs should be reordered alphabetically
The tab colors should be changed
